title: Add retry budget to the dispatch loop
body:
## Summary

The dispatch loop should stop retrying after three attempts.
Operators need a visible counter on `cw status` so they can tell a stuck ticket
from a slow one.

## Acceptance criteria

1. AC1: Retry count must be capped at three per ticket.
2. AC2: The status output shows the remaining retry budget.

comments.body: Operator note: keep the cap configurable, but default to three attempts.
R1 — use the existing lane config rather than a new setting.

Analysis: the loop silently doubles the budget on resume.
